17.title: Slug for product titles
17.description:
Add `slug_unique(title, taken)` to app.py: the slug, with `-2`, `-3` appended while it is in `taken`.

Acceptance:
- [ ] `python -c "from app import slug_unique; print(slug_unique('A b', ['a-b']))"` prints `a-b-2`

18.title: Slug transliteration
18.description:
Slugs of titles with accents must be ASCII. Use the `unidecode` package to do it.

Acceptance:
- [ ] `python -c "from app import slug; print(slug('Café'))"` prints `cafe`

19.title: Slug length cap
19.description:
Cap slugs at 40 characters.

Acceptance:
- [ ] `python -c "from app import slug; print(len(slug('x' * 99)))"` prints `40`

20.title: Trim repeated dashes
20.description:
Collapse repeated dashes in a slug.

Acceptance:
- [ ] `python -c "from app import slug; print(slug('a  b'))"` prints `a-b`
